nodes.title: SG-2.8 · Mocked-fs unit test checks every manifest.json path against present files
nodes.body:
Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json lists 14 assets. Existing tests (tests/manifestLoaderMocked.test.ts, tests/manifestDanglingMocked.test.ts) mock fs with synthetic manifests but none checks the committed manifest against a list of files. Desired behavior: a mocked-fs test reads the committed manifest and verifies every asset path is in a given list of files. Expected result: manifest and asset folders cannot drift apart unnoticed. Why: keeps manifest and assets in sync.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the committed manifest.json and a file list that contains every manifest path, when the test runs, then no path is reported missing.
- Given a file list lacking one manifest path, when the check runs, then exactly that path is reported missing.


## Scope
- In scope: One mocked-fs unit test against the committed manifest.json
- In scope: A small pure helper to compare manifest paths with a file list
- Out of scope: Adding or changing asset files
- Out of scope: Changing manifest.json content
- Out of scope: Browser or e2e checks
- Preserve: Existing loadManifestFile and loadManifestWithFallback behavior and tests


## Technical constraints
- Vitest with vi.mock('node:fs'); no real asset directory reads in the new test


## Definition of done
- Test passes and covers every committed manifest path


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Every committed manifest path is checked against a list of present files with fs mocked
nodes.body:
Context: loadManifestFile checks existence per asset via existsSync but offers no reusable comparison against a file list. Desired behavior: an exported pure helper returns manifest asset paths absent from a supplied file list; the test feeds it the committed manifest read through mocked fs. Expected result: drift between manifest.json and asset folders fails the test. Why: prevents silent drift.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the committed manifest and a list of all its paths, when the helper runs, then it returns an empty array.
- Given the list with one path removed, when the helper runs, then it returns that single path.
- Given node:fs is mocked, when the test runs, then no real asset file is touched.


## Scope
- In scope: findMissingAssetPaths helper
- In scope: Mocked-fs test of committed manifest
- Out of scope: Asset creation
- Out of scope: Schema changes
- Preserve: Existing loader exports


## Technical constraints
- Helper must be pure and not throw


## Definition of done
- Helper exported and tested


## Clarifying questions
- None
